edits.old: The contract declares no foreign key and no reference across a service boundary, and it creates nothing in another service's schema (DP-01). The ALS reference has no row and no column: it is a required fact of the body, recorded with the booking on the decision record (BR3).
edits.new:
The contract declares no foreign key and no reference across a service boundary, and it creates nothing in another service's schema (DP-01). The ALS reference has no row and no column: it is a required fact of the body, recorded with the booking on the decision record (BR3).

SCR-14, which binds this body through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19), has four states: empty, loading, error and no access. Error shows the refused body with MSG-GEN-001 and its field; no access is the case where the capability area Treatment and offer is not granted.

Reference data: this contract reads its lists and parameters through the reference-data contract (DP-06, DP-07); the parameter key for the planInstallmentClock cadence is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S2-E3010-CON-20).
